claim_scope: RK-003 closure/offline evidence only; this contract never awards tracker or gate credit and does not supersede the RK-006 compatibility-patch authority.

network_contract.acquisition: DNF configured network sources are limited to the three reviewed Rocky 10.2 base URLs, with exact signed local metadata first; inherited proxy variables are removed, every RPM is digest and header-signature checked, but DNF redirect destinations are not claimed to be isolated.
network_contract.offline_replay: One fresh empty installroot resolves the original roots from exact local file repositories, and a separate fresh empty installroot is populated only from explicit local paths to the captured RPM set with all configured repositories disabled and proxy variables pointed to loopback discard.
network_contract.scope: This proves exact-snapshot local repository solving and repository-disabled explicit-file replay at the DNF transaction boundary. It is not kernel-level network isolation, and independent network-isolation review remains required before RK-003 credit.

success_blockers: The closure/offline artifact still requires independent review and durable archival before it may be bound into the toolchain lock.
Kernel-level network isolation was not proved; repository-disabled file-only replay and proxy-loopback defense are narrower evidence.
The minimal requested config has not been resolved twice by the exact Rocky process_configs.sh and olddefconfig pipeline.
make LLVM=1 rustavailable has not run in the reviewed offline buildroot against the exact source and resolved config.
A production kernel build has not bound its final .config to the independently resolved config.
The RK-006 compatibility patch series remains independently governed and receives no credit from this evidence.
RK-002, RK-004, RK-005, RK-006, and RS-001 are outside this phase and remain uncredited.
The committed phase plan still marks closure-offline unimplemented; its authority and validator must be reconciled in an independently reviewed change before credit or review ingestion.

The current RK-003 toolchain authority maps the llvm-config probe to llvm-0:21.1.8-1.el10.x86_64, but the captured binary is owned by llvm-devel-0:21.1.8-1.el10.x86_64; this mapping must be reconciled before credit or review ingestion.
